technical.title: VideoNexus separates video perception from evidence-driven planning
technical.summary: VideoNexus is a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning to handle long videos without overloading context.
technical.why: It offers an efficient way to manage long-video context limits for AI vision systems.

technical.title: GridDriver enables onboard BEV-based language planning and reasoning
technical.summary: GridDriver combines lightweight spatio-temporal BEV perception with a shared LLM to perform trajectory prediction, natural-language navigation, and scene question answering efficiently on-board.
technical.why: It demonstrates how to combine vision-based perception with language models for autonomous driving.

technical.title: FIRE-Drive improves end-to-end diffusion planning with risk evaluation
technical.summary: FIRE-Drive is a feasibility-informed risk evaluation framework designed to address trajectory initialization and mode selection issues in diffusion-based autonomous driving models.
technical.why: It helps improve the safety and reliability of diffusion-based driving planners.

technical.title: Open recipe for post-training multimodal reasoning with distillation
technical.summary: Researchers present M3OPD-Reasoner, a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models across image STEM, perception, and video domains using multi-teacher on-policy distillation.
technical.why: It provides valuable open-source methodologies for advancing multi-domain visual reasoning in VLMs.

technical.title: EgoLink challenge benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence and interaction
technical.summary: The EgoLink Challenge benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence by evaluating social reasoning in videos and interactive service agents through dialogue and tool use.
technical.why: It sets new evaluation standards for first-person perception and interactive agent systems.

technical.title: RoboTeam benchmarks real-time vision-based control of many robot arms
technical.summary: RoboTeam is a simulated benchmark where agents use camera images alone to control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time across 36 collaborative tasks.
technical.why: It pushes multi-agent robotic control benchmarks closer to real-time, multi-arm complexities.

technical.title: AscendGYM benchmark optimizes kernels for real-world Ascend NPU workloads
technical.summary: AscendGYM is a cost-aware kernel optimization benchmark featuring 48 kernels paired with test cases collected from real-world LLM training and inference tasks on Ascend NPUs.
technical.why: It helps engineers map kernel optimization directly to real-world hardware performance.

technical.title: Case study investigates whether decision models localize detected anomalies
technical.summary: A case study on Clef-flash evaluates whether decision models answering questions about images can also accurately localize the anomalies they detect in industrial inspection.
technical.why: It reveals important insights into the internal localization capabilities of classification-focused vision models.

technical.title: ASTRA simulation framework tests marine autonomous surface vehicles
technical.summary: ASTRA is an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim combining marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and ROS 2 autonomy interfaces.
technical.why: It offers a realistic virtual environment for developing and testing marine robotics.

technical.title: SID AI releases SID-2 agentic search model with swarm mode
technical.summary: SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning that achieves 0.720 NDCG using a 12-agent swarm setup.
technical.why: It showcases state-of-the-art performance for multi-agent search architectures.

business.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
business.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

business.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
business.summary: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

business.title: Data center policy dominated the midterms. The 'Virginia of Europe' is the latest battleground
business.summary: Data center policy has become a key election issue in Spain, creating an obstacle to existing deals and potentially costing billions of dollars in investment.

business.title: Genesis AI Raises $500M At $3.5B Valuation To Bring Its Robots To Factories And Warehouses
business.summary: Genesis AI, a startup teaching robots to perform physical tasks by learning from human movements, announced Tuesday it has raised $500 million in Series A funding at a $3.5 billion valuation.

business.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
business.summary: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round.

business.title: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO
business.summary: Gerstner told CNBC that he's looking to put five time as much money into Anthropic as he's ever put into an IPO.

business.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
business.summary: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.
